metadata.name: fmt2-kolla-storage-rdma-promotion
metadata.description: Gate FMT2 Kolla storage and RDMA promotion after API, Nova, Neutron, and observability baselines pass.

variables.name: sec_host
variables.description: Current positive-control R630 with live ConnectX links.

variables.name: ter_host
variables.description: Storage/provisioning anchor and pairwise RDMA peer.

variables.name: pri_host
variables.description: Primary Kolla controller candidate; RDMA promotion waits for ConnectX repair.

stages.summary: Require API/control plane baseline with Cinder disabled before any storage service promotion.
command: source /etc/kolla/admin-openrc.sh && openstack endpoint list && openstack service list && openstack hypervisor list && openstack network agent list && printf '%s\n' 'Cinder remains disabled before promotion' 'API/control plane baseline with Cinder disabled' 'keep RDMA out of OpenStack scheduling until later gates pass'

stages.summary: Run Glance image import/export smoke before attaching persistent block storage.
command: source /etc/kolla/admin-openrc.sh && printf '%s\n' 'Glance image import/export smoke: upload tiny test image, download it, compare checksum, then remove only the test artifact.'

stages.summary: Run Nova ephemeral instance smoke after Glance succeeds.
command: source /etc/kolla/admin-openrc.sh && printf '%s\n' 'Nova ephemeral instance smoke: create rfc1918.smoke.tiny, boot cirros or equivalent tiny image, confirm ACTIVE, then delete.'

stages.summary: Validate NFSv3/NFSv4 backend reachability from NASA or ter before enabling Cinder.
command: printf '%s\n' 'NFS backend smoke' 'NFSv3/NFSv4 backend smoke from NASA or ter' 'validate mount, write, fsync, read, delete, and unmount from the intended Kolla node path before any Cinder backend is enabled.'

stages.summary: Promote Cinder NFS only after API, Glance, Nova, and NFS smoke gates pass.
command: printf '%s\n' 'Cinder NFS backend pilot' 'enable Cinder only for the NFS backend pilot after successful NFS backend smoke' 'create one test volume, attach to one test instance, write/read, detach, delete volume, and keep backend disabled if any step fails.'

stages.summary: Run pairwise RDMA smoke over independent ConnectX paths before any RDMA storage backend promotion.
command: printf '%s\n' 'Pairwise RoCEv2 RDMA smoke between sec and ter, then pri after ConnectX repair' 'do not use ConnectX LACP before pairwise RDMA evidence' 'keep independent 50GbE links with protocol-layer multipath until one-path-failure evidence is clean.'

stages.summary: Promote NVMe-oF or iSER only after pairwise RoCEv2 smoke passes.
command: printf '%s\n' 'NVMe-oF promotion gate' 'NVMe-oF or iSER backend pilot' 'validate discovery, connect, multipath, fio smoke, disconnect, and rollback before scheduling OpenStack storage workloads onto RDMA backends.'

stages.summary: Promote NFS-RDMA only after standard NFS and pairwise RDMA gates pass.
command: printf '%s\n' 'NFS-RDMA promotion gate' 'NFS-RDMA backend pilot' 'validate mount over RDMA, write/read/fsync, server/client counters, unmount, fallback, and rollback before production scheduling.'

stages.summary: Run one-path-failure and reboot conformance before marking storage/RDMA promoted.
command: printf '%s\n' 'one-path-failure' 'reboot conformance' 'disable one independent 50GbE path, verify protocol-layer multipath/failover behavior, restore path, reboot participating nodes, and re-run API/Nova/storage/RDMA smoke before promotion.'
